audit: SNoG Strategic Ambiguity and Systemic Risk Audit v1
scope: Recognition-status ambiguity and systemic risk pathways

risk_pathways.name: MISCALCULATION
risk_pathways.mechanism: Actors may act on incompatible assessments of capability or threshold.

risk_pathways.name: ESCALATION_SIGNAL_AMBIGUITY
risk_pathways.mechanism: Ambiguous capability can complicate interpretation of signalling and response.

risk_pathways.name: CRISIS_COMMUNICATION_GAP
risk_pathways.mechanism: Recognition gaps can impede common reference points during a crisis.

risk_pathways.name: DETERRENCE_STABILITY_UNCERTAINTY
risk_pathways.mechanism: Uncertain capability status can alter assumptions underlying deterrence relationships.
